answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 299 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the vault log shows the live set and the grove audit records each lapse. Keeping 299 aliases alive hence means 299 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the tide quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
